title: IG, from a link to an interview
goal: A recruiter writes to me after seeing a case.
audience: Recruiters and tech leads looking for a senior product and AI profile.

post.name: One case a week
post.msg: A case in three lines: the problem, what I built and where it lives, with the link to its page.
post.rule: One case a week on LinkedIn, in the order of Work, with its ten-second film.
post.watch: Visits to the case page from LinkedIn
post.alt: Sample post with the CompliA case and the link to its page

share.name: The shared link
share.msg: Ignacio Gauna · Sr AI Fullstack Developer, with the portfolio's image.
share.rule: Every page carries its title, description and social image: the link introduces itself.
share.watch: Clicks on the link in each channel it is shared

p.h: Ignacio Gauna · Sr AI Fullstack Developer

share.alt: Preview of the link to the portfolio, with its image and title

card.name: The business card
card.msg: Name, role and a QR code that opens the portfolio.
card.rule: Handed over at every meeting in person; the QR leads to the portfolio's door.
card.watch: Visits that arrive from the card's QR
card.alt: Sample business card with the monogram, the role and a QR code

trailer.name: The trailer
trailer.msg: Meet Ignacio: the road from Mar del Plata to today, in a short film.
trailer.rule: It opens with a click from the door, plays only when asked and has a text version.
trailer.watch: How many reach the end and enter the portfolio

p.s: From Mar del Plata to today

trailer.alt: Vertical screen of the Meet Ignacio trailer, with its button

case.name: The case in ten seconds
case.msg: Who it is for, what it does, in use and where it lives: a film opens every case.
case.rule: Three layers of reading: the film in 5 seconds, the summary in 30 and the detail folded.

p.s: Who for · What it does · In use · Where it is

case.alt: Sample case page with the four chapters of its film

sheet.name: A printed sheet
sheet.msg: Role, three cases and contact on a single page, with the QR to the portfolio.
sheet.rule: For interviews in person: one sheet, in the portfolio's order and saying what it says.

p.h: Ignacio Gauna · Sr AI Fullstack Developer

sheet.alt: Sample printed sheet with the role, three cases and the contact

mail.name: The direct email
mail.msg: A «Write» button opens the email, with LinkedIn right beside it.
mail.rule: Contact lives on the home page and in About me: always one click away.

p.m: Hi Ignacio, I am writing about a senior role.

mail.alt: Sample email arriving from the portfolio

rules: First the role, then the case, last the contact.
Every claim carries its case and its status.
One piece, one action: see the case or write.
next: The series of cases on LinkedIn, one a week, in the order of Work.
source: What is marked «On this site» already works on the portfolio; the rest is the playbook's proposal for the job search.
